activity.notes: Danylo Romanovych, ruler of Galicia-Volhynia, was crowned king of Rus' in 1253 and ruled until his death in 1264. ATLAS uses Kingdom of Ruthenia for the crowned royal phase, corresponding to the polity also commonly described as Galicia-Volhynia.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Danylo Romanovych
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia identifies Danylo Romanovych as prince of Galicia-Volhynia and king of Rus' from 1253.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Galicia-Volhynia
sources.citation_text: The historical overview treats Danylo's mid-thirteenth-century rule and royal coronation as the high point of the Galicia-Volhynia polity.
